adds.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling 1 March 2018
adds.summary: On 1 March 2018 in ADI 4275 the Supreme Federal Court gave Article 58 of Law 6.015/1973 a Constitution-conforming interpretation recognizing the right of transgender persons to alter first name and gender in the civil registry by averbação without transgenitalization surgery, with all justices recognizing that right and a majority holding that no judicial authorization is required.
